name: Themistocles
title: General (Athens)
note: Repelled Persia at the Battle of Salamis (480 BC)

name: Miltiades
title: General (Athens)
note: Victory at the Battle of Marathon (490 BC)

name: Alcibiades
title: General (Athens)
note: Adventurer of the Peloponnesian War; switched sides repeatedly

name: Demosthenes
title: Orator and statesman (Athens)
note: Orator who opposed Philip II of Macedon

name: Ptolemy I
title: General (Diadochi)
note: General of Alexander; founded the Ptolemaic dynasty in Egypt
